normative_extracts.quote: useOptimistic lets you show a different state while an async action is underway, automatically reverting to the authoritative base state when the action settles.
Cancel outgoing refetches, snapshot the previous cache value, apply the optimistic update, and roll back to the snapshot on error.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Separates confirmed server state from an ephemeral speculative overlay, using mutation sequence IDs and rollback snapshots to preserve consistency under out-of-order network responses.

production_failures.symptom: User toggles Like ON then OFF quickly, and the UI flickers back to ON 400ms later
production_failures.root_cause: An earlier in-flight refetch or slower first POST resolved after the second mutation and overwrote newer optimistic state.
production_failures.mitigation: Cancel pending queries before mutating, tag mutations with monotonic sequence IDs, and only reconcile on the latest settled mutation.

production_failures.symptom: Clicking an optimistically created item opens a 404 page
production_failures.root_cause: Optimistic list insertion assigned a temporary client UUID before the server returned the real database ID, and navigation used the temporary ID.
production_failures.mitigation: Disable deep-link navigation on pending items or route via stable client-generated idempotency keys accepted by the server.
